Paper overview The rest of the paper is organized as follows. In Section 2 we prove Theorem 3. The proof of Theorem 6 appears in Section 3. The main idea behind its proof is to show that there exists a property Πh,w,b (specifically, the one defined in (1)) which encodes the property of being a pseudo-random graph. It is then not hard to show that such a property cannot be tested using a constant number of queries.
